description: Get an account's Geode profile: display name, location, tags, bio, links and linked app accounts. Read-only; no signature. Optional `caller`: the account whose view to read (for caller-dependent results). Results are paginated with `offset` and `limit` (default 50, max 200).

caller.description: Optional account address (SS58) to run the query as

name: geode_profile_get_account_profile
title: Profile: get account profile
